breakingChangesNotes: In the Cortex XDR - Cloud Data Exfiltration Response playbook, the *username* and *Username* context paths were updated from **PaloAltoNetworksXDR.Incident.alerts.user_name** to **PaloAltoNetworksXDR.Case.Issues.user_name**, to match the output of the ***xdr-case-list*** command that replaced the deprecated ***xdr-get-incident-extra-data*** command in the calling playbook. In the Cortex XDR - XCloud Token Theft Response playbook, the *alertID* context paths were updated from **PaloAltoNetworksXDR.Incident.alerts.alert_id** to **PaloAltoNetworksXDR.Case.Issues.issue_id** for the same reason. In the Cortex XDR - XCloud Cryptojacking - Set Verdict playbook, the verdict condition context paths were updated from **PaloAltoNetworksXDR.Incident.alerts.severity** to **PaloAltoNetworksXDR.Case.Issues.severity** for the same reason. Custom playbooks or automations that rely on the previous **PaloAltoNetworksXDR.Incident.alerts** context paths must be updated to the new context paths.
